Notwithstanding section 135C.1, subsection 21, a 14 pediatric palliative care center may provide care and services 15 to individuals who require the services of a registered 16 or licensed practical nurse on a nonemergency basis, and 17 may provide accommodation, board, personal assistance, and 18 other essential daily living activities to fewer than three 19 individuals at any one time. 20 NEW SUBSECTION . 8B. “Pediatric palliative care patient” 21 means an individual described by all of the following: 22 a. The individual is under twenty-one years of age. 23 b. The individual has been diagnosed with a chronic, 24 complex, life-threatening illness that is expected to shorten 25 the individual’s life expectancy. 26 c.
